title: Every platform's LOOK line tells the agent to read the element back with page.look after a hand-written look change, before telling the customer it is done
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. In the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with dependencies installed (pnpm install), run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/ds-slot-worn.test.mjs
S2: Record the result of the three 'LOOK line: a change by hand is read back' tests.
expect: For wordpress, joomla and emdash, a mode with a shell gets in its LOOK line: 'After a change by hand, read the element again with `page.look` and tell the customer the value it now shows — never that it is done without that reading.'
A mode without a shell (Writer) does not get that sentence.
The three tests are ok and the run exits 0.
evidence: Stand 09–10/10/2026, WordPress T3: the agent wrote a look by hand and claimed success without reading the computed value back.
fence: Mechanism only: the rule's text in the context. Not covered: whether the model follows it.

tests: LOOK line: a change by hand is read back with page.look before the customer is told: wordpress
LOOK line: a change by hand is read back with page.look before the customer is told: joomla
LOOK line: a change by hand is read back with page.look before the customer is told: emdash
